admission.justification: Spans knowledge_code_pairing.py and mcp/tools/knowledge.py, is verified by multi-page and leaf-precedence tests, and jointly ensures knowledge_read resolves live code trees without manual SHA passing.

applicability: Converted-memory knowledge_read calls across paged, record, marks, and drafting query views.
conditions: Resolves paired code root in four-tier precedence: explicit repositoryRoot, leaf contractPath or sibling enclosure worktree, configured repository match by repo_id or memoryRoot, then workspace_root fallback without guessing unconfigured paths.
Observes clean HEAD or dirty working-tree capture on fresh and continuation reads without mutating raw request.code_tree_id so _resume_refusal remains bound to caller-supplied overrides.
exclusions: A caller-named repositoryRoot that resolves no Git tree still refuses selected_input_unavailable.
When no code root can be resolved, pairing returns None and currentness honestly reports unverifiable.
statement: knowledge_read automatically pairs memoryRoot to its code repository on every fresh and continuation page using explicit-argument, leaf-enclosure, configured-repository, and fallback precedence while keeping _resume_refusal bound to the raw request codeTreeId.
title: knowledge_read auto-pairs memoryRoot to code across pages and resumes
